description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to big number exponentiation, specifically modular exponentiation, used in cryptographic algorithms. It includes functions such as BN_mod_exp and BN_mod_mul, and shows indications of being a part of OpenSSL's cryptographic library.

methods.name: int BN_mod_exp_simple(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * p,const BIGNUM * m,BN_CTX * ctx)
